scientific_integrity: Proof includes explicit hypotheses and known input formula; the reproducibility checker performs independent finite tests but does not establish the infinite limits. No independent review has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Uniform translation parameter and standard affine contracted rotations only; weak distributional and moment limits, not an orbit-capture-time theorem. Earlier exact plateau formulas are explicitly credited. Potential prior distributional treatment in historically inaccessible 1987 and 1999 primary texts remains a priority risk.
title: A universal joint scaling law for mode-locked periods of contracted rotations
